title: How Smudge Drew His Crown
altTitles: The Villain Was Just a Mistake
description: Before he was a villain, Smudge was a mistake: a blot the Author never wiped away. He watched the heroes get clean lines and bright edges. Then a shard of the Nib fell. #stickfigure #animation #villainorigin #INKLIGHT #shorts
topic: INK-10 lore origin mini-film (F7 authored mini-film + F3 lore drop), lead Smudge: the blot left behind, the heroes drawn clean, failed self-drawings, the fallen Nib shard, the crown, the goons rise; one lore beat = the Nib (plus the First Draft)

snippets.STYLE: Cinematic 3D animated film. The characters are stylized stick figures: glossy matte-black ink bodies with uniform thin cylindrical limbs, perfectly round glossy black heads with no facial features except two small glowing oval eyes, and a thin emissive rim light in each character's signature color. They are set inside a hyper-detailed, physically lit 3D environment with volumetric light shafts, atmospheric haze, real materials, shallow depth of field and film-grade color grading.
snippets.BOLT: BOLT: an average-height black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, electric cyan (#22D3EE) glowing eyes and rim light, a long flowing cyan scarf that trails light when moving.
snippets.PIP: PIP: a short, small black ink stick figure (half BOLT's height) with a round glossy head, amber (#FFB020) glowing eyes and rim light, oversized brass aviator goggles on the forehead, a boxy amber backpack with antennae.
snippets.NOVA: NOVA: a tall slender black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, magenta (#FF3DA5) glowing eyes and rim light, a single curved topknot line rising from the head, carrying a glowing magenta bo staff.
snippets.BRICK: BRICK: a large black ink stick figure with thick heavy limbs (three times normal thickness) and a round glossy head, lime green (#7CFF4F) glowing eyes and rim light, a lime visor band across the eyes.
snippets.SMUDGE: SMUDGE: a tall black ink stick figure whose body constantly drips and smears ink, a round head with a jagged three-point crown spike, crimson (#FF2E3A) glowing eyes and rim light, leaving smeared ink footprints.
snippets.BLOT: SMUDGE (early form, before he has a body or a crown): a small glossy black ink blot, a wet domed puddle of ink with a deep crimson sheen, no limbs, no head, no crown, two small crimson (#FF2E3A) glowing oval eye-dots and a thin crimson rim light around its edge, leaving a smeared glossy ink trail.
snippets.HALF: SMUDGE (half-formed, before his crown): a thin, unsteady black ink stick figure whose body keeps dripping and sagging, a round glossy head with NO crown and nothing on top, two small crimson (#FF2E3A) glowing oval eye-dots and a crimson rim light, standing in a puddle of his own smeared ink.
snippets.GOON: GOON: a plain black ink stick figure with a round glossy head, two small steel-grey (#9AA4B2) glowing oval eye-dots and a steel-grey rim light, no accessories, no markings, no crimson anywhere on the body.
snippets.PAGE: SET: the first page of the First Draft sketchbook seen at miniature scale, a colossal sheet of thick cream paper stretching away like a vast pale landscape, visible paper fibers and soft pencil-grain texture, gentle waves and a deep center crease, curled page edges rising like cliffs, faint grey graphite dust, lit from far above by a huge warm desk lamp with volumetric haze and floating paper dust; blank paper, pencil texture only, no writing.
snippets.NEG: Avoid: text, letters, numbers, handwriting, logos, mouths, noses, teeth, brows, human faces, human hands, human arms, anyone holding a pen, skin, hair, clothing beyond the listed accessories, extra limbs, fused or merged bodies, fingers except three rounded nubs in close-ups, blood, gore, flat or empty backgrounds, 2D drawing look.
snippets.SOUL: stick figure, NOT a human, no face, no skin, no clothing except listed accessory. Deep focus, the whole image sharp to the frame edges, full frame edge to edge, no borders. Vertical 9:16 frame.

qc: N10: Smudge look — S12–S15 must match L01 DESC_SMUDGE and ref-smudge exactly (jagged three-point crown spike, constant drips, smeared footprints, crimson #FF2E3A eyes and rim); S1–S11 are his crownless forms (blot, then half-formed figure with a plain round head): any crown before S11's drawing beat = re-roll. S4/S5 pass all five cast refs in fixed order but only tokens 1–4 are in the prompt, on purpose, so the crowned ref does not leak onto the blot; check it stays crownless. S11 SDi endFrame lands the crown: crown must be black ink with crimson rim, not gold, once set. Drift — S4/S5 4-cast CS4: Pip half Bolt's height, Brick's limbs 3× thick, Nova's topknot one curved line and staff in hand, Bolt the only scarf. Faces — eye-dots only on everyone (blot included): any mouth, teeth or brows = reject; S12 'eyes narrowing' must read as eye arcs only. Hands — lines draw themselves (S2, S4): any human hand, arm or pen-holder even 1 frame = reject. Limbs/fusion — S5 tendril never touches a hero; S13/S14 goons stand apart, no goon merging into Smudge or each other; count limbs on S7/S8 melt beats. Goons — plain black, steel-grey eye-dots and rim, no accessories, no crimson smears (ref is ref-grey, not ref-goon, for that reason). Style — the page is a lit 3D paper landscape, never a flat white card; S4's golden lines must swell into glossy 3D bodies, not stay 2D drawings; S9/S15 low light must keep rims visible. Text — the page is blank (pencil texture only); any glyphs = mask or re-roll. Labels — hero tags at top (S4), SMUDGE tag at bottom (S12): never over a face; nudge if a head sits in that band. Sound — drip-tink at 0:00 (frame 1) and at every shard beat (S10, S11); final drip-tink at 3:58 must be audibly off-key; music bed plus per-section ambience means no silence over 1.5s anywhere (check media QC gaps, especially S9→S10 dip to black). Close — 'Mine.' is a whisper (re-take the VO if it reads full voice), then hard cut from the crown glint straight to the end card: no fade; if the card does not open on black, add a 0.5s black hold in edit. CS4 at 9:16 is unverified: S4, S5, S12–S15 fall back to hf-seedance-2-5 from their keyframes (already in the script) if aspect or look fails. Global gate (brief §0.3): accent hue shift >6 frames / missing accessory / size swap = re-roll; 3rd limb or fused limb ≥3 frames = re-roll; any mouth, nose, teeth, brows, skin or human face even 1 frame = reject; flat/white/empty bg, 2D look, lost rim light or blood = re-roll; any legible or pseudo-glyph text in a plate = mask or re-roll (all real text is Remotion labels). Check sourceSpec width/height/duration (720×1280) every clip.
